Dear James, 
Like I have said in an earlier email. I am looking for an 
"investing partner" to match (50%/50%) the money Russian 
Venture Capital plans to invest in USA based Biotechnology. 
They will provide half of the capital to develop a variety of 
technologies that are of interest to their country. For their 
investment they get commercialization rights to the 
technologies they finance for Russia and the CIS. For us, on 
the USA side, this is a major source of capital to start a series 
of companies that have great potential as therapeutic 
technologies, and we get commercialization rights for the 
USA, and rest of the world markets. Basically, we get the 
rights that are valuable to us at "half price". 
Over the next several years our plan is to identify seven/eight 
technologies that are worthy of development. RVC has 
already agreed to finance the first (MAJI) and is looking at the 
next two—Prediction Biosciences, and OvationBio. I have 
several more currently in diligence. (The original Investor 
Presentation made in Moscow is attached) 
So, I am looking for a source of capital that thinks this is an 
interesting investment theme, and is willing to consider the 
idea as something they might want to implement. My belief 
is that there is more money in NYC, seeking an investment 
home, then there are "quality investment ideas". I could be 
wrong, but I have to believe that people running a lot of 
capital in New York would want to hear new, creative, and 
GOOD new investment ideas. I think this idea is the kind of 
idea that is worth a look, and worth serious consideration. I 
think we are talking $150M over a five year horizon.

Dear James, 
Like I have said in an earlier email. I am looking for an "investing partner" to match 
(50%/50%) the money Russian Venture Capital plans to invest in USA based 
Biotechnology. They will provide half of the capital to develop a variety of technologies 
that are of interest to their country. For their investment they get commercialization 
rights to the technologies they finance for Russia and the CIS. For us, on the USA side, 
this is a major source of capital to start a series of companies that have great potential 
as therapeutic technologies, and we get commercialization rights for the USA, and rest 
of the world markets. Basically, we get the rights that are valuable to us at "half price". 
Over the next several years our plan is to identify seven/eight technologies that are

To All Eclipse Lacrosse Players, 
Please be advised, we have activated our registration system to accept a deposit 
to confirm your spot to join our 2015 Eclipse Summer Program. 
The deadline to submit a deposit is December 31st. Our online registration for

http://eclipselacrosseclub.assn.la/Registration/Default.asp?n=75007&org=eclips 
elacrosseclub 
The remaining balance will be due by March V'. As indicated all tournament

tournament fees in our March 1" installment. 
We will be sending another detailed email to each class year, explaining all 
costs, team schedules, and logistics. 
Eclipse Lacrosse Summer Events 
Summer Tournaments: 
We are pleased to announce our summer tournament schedule for 2015. We 
were invited to many of the top events for this upcoming summer and have 
chosen our schedule for very specific reasons. Please visit our website to see 
each team's tournament schedule (Please see the tournament schedule Tab & 
select the correct team). 
Please note we did not schedule any teams to play during the 4th of July holiday 
weekend. Although there are a couple great tournaments that weekend, we 
believe our players should be with their families. 
EFTA_R1_00684619 
EFTA02089678
--- PAGE 2 ---
Camps: All Eclipse Players will attend a 4-day Curriculum Camp. Our 
"curriculum camps" this summer will take place prior to our first team 
tournaments. Our goal is to try to eliminate all conflicts with other lacrosse 
showcases our players may be attending. Reminder: The main reason we have 
our camp, clinics, and play-day structure vs 6 weeks of practice is to maximize 
participation and enable the players to have exposure to all Eclipse Coaches, MLL 
players, and College players. Being taught the game of lacrosse by multiple 
coaches in the summer is much better for a player's development (compared to 
just being coached by only two coaches the entire summer). 
To get a sense of the caliber of coaching who will be at our camps, please see the 
list of last year's "guest" coaches on our website. 
Clinics / Play Days: Before our second and third tournaments, our youth club 
teams will go through a total of four days of lacrosse instruction focused on 
fundamental lacrosse development training. Before our third and fourth 
tournaments, our High School club teams will go through a total of four days of 
lacrosse instruction focused on fundamental lacrosse development training. 
Clinic sessions will include fundamental coaching from current MLL, Division I 
college players, and Eclipse Directors. We are currently in discussions with other 
club programs to set up "Play Days" to compete as teams in preparation for 
tournaments. We will NOT send teams to tournaments unprepared. 
Families looking to schedule summer vacations or other sport camps 
Eclipse Curriculum Camps, Clinic, and Play-Days, exact dates will most likely come 
out in January. However, below is a rough draft of our summer logistics. We 
hope this helps in your family planning. 
- We will NOT have any lacrosse events from Monday June 29th to Monday July 
6th. (if we have several rainouts and need to make up days, we will do our best 
to leave this week open, HOWEVER, we may use June 29'h and June 30'h as make-
up days) 
- Rough draft of High School Schedule (2016, 2017, 2018) 
- Curriculum Camp Dates: June 15th, 16th, 17th, 18th 
- Clinic Days / Play Days: Week of July 13`h —18`h
- Rough draft of 2019 Schedule 
- Curriculum Camp Dates: June 15`h, 16'h, 17th, le 
- Clinic Days / Play Days: TBA 
- Rough draft of Youth Schedule (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023) 
- Curriculum Camp Dates: June r, 9th 10`h, 11th
- Clinic Days / Play Days: TBA

- 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 — No Eclipse Lacrosse events will occur after July 
132" (last tournament day). 
- 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 — No Eclipse Lacrosse event will occur after July

Canaan". 
Team Logistics 
Coaching: We spend a great deal of time assembling our coaching staff. Last 
year we had over 55 coaches working with our players, many of whom have 
played at the highest levels. Coaching is the most important ingredient in 
developing players and Eclipse Lacrosse Club has put an emphasis on the 
strength of our staff. Our High School Level Club Team coaches can be found on 
our website. Our youth team coaches will be updated on our website in the 
coming weeks. Many of our youth coaches will be returning from last year + we 
will have new coaches. 
Hotel reservations: We are currently working with different hotel groups on 
securing the best discounted rates for our teams this summer. We will be 
sending out this information very soon. Teams going to Long Island will not need 
hotel rooms for this tournament. All other tournaments will require hotel 
stays. 
Uniforms: Our 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020 teams have already ordered 
uniforms for the summer (you will be wearing the same uniforms you used this 
fall). As for our 2021, 2022, and 2023 groups, we will be sending you a link to 
order your uniform. Uniform orders will be managed via our apparel vender 
Force5 lacrosse. All players will be required to order a pinnie, shorts, and t-shirt 
for the summer. Estimated cost of uniform = $80. 
REMINDER: We will be sending another email today to each class year with 
more details. 
If you have any questions, please contact us. 
We hope everyone has a wonderful thanksgiving holiday! 
Regards, 
Eclipse Board of Directors 
www.EclipselacrosseClub.com
